name: Prismatic / Lab
displayName: 棱镜实验 · 光的材质
description: 光学玻璃微距、光束切面与光谱焦散，带真实生成透明棱镜和可编辑矢量光学材质。

canvas.adaptation: Fixed 16:9 art board scales without cropping on mobile. Portrait requires the documented composition recipe; not automatic reflow.

audio.note: Silent material study. Narration, character, voice and speaking rate are unchanged and remain user controlled.

dependencies.fonts: Local Arial, Georgia and Courier New; no remote fonts. Metrics vary by platform.

variants.name: 光谱暗室
variants.recipe: Run preview.html?variant=spectral-nocturne. Dark optical bench, cool light slit, spectrum fan and generated-glass macro crop.

variants.name: 珍珠工作室
variants.recipe: Run preview.html?variant=pearl-studio. Warm reflective bench, softened dispersion, changed glass pose and vector-construction detail crop.

usage.remix: Reuse the transparent generated prism, separate vector caustic and editable geometric glass. Swap prism image for an authorized product cutout; preserve the source record. Text is ordinary HTML. Query parameters tune spread, glow and camera amplitude.
usage.avoid: Layered 2D images and gradients are illustrative art direction, not real-time 3D, ray tracing, physical refraction or measured optics. Do not use as evidence of product performance.
usage.motion: 0–1.8s slit reveal and macro pullback; 1.1–4s title and settle; 2.7–7s beam and caustic travel; 7–9s close inspection detail; 10.3–12s quieter final light. Time is analytic with no random or CSS animation.
usage.portrait: At 9:16, place headline in top 24%, prism at center 50%, caustic below it and phase at bottom. Remove edition/footer and detail inset rather than shrink all labels. Current preview only letterboxes.
usage.captions: Keep bottom 90px free for production captions by removing the decorative footer and shortening caustic. Preview labels are not subtitles.

provenance.creator: Short Video theme-pack contributors
provenance.scope: HTML, CSS, JS, spectral-caustic.svg and faceted-glass.svg. Original composition; no third-party code, UI assets or inspiration-source claims.

provenance.source: Repository examples/image-material-study/assets/prism.webp, inspected before reuse; exact binary copy. Native AI image tool, generated 2026-10-01; model not returned and not asserted.
provenance.scope: prism.webp and poster.png containing that image. No third-party photo or model download.
